The '''Infinity Plain''' was a plain located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] on which was situated a [[Kwa/Legends|Kwa]] [[Star Temple]] that contained an [[Infinity Gate]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Infinity Plain had fallen within the territory of the [[Singing Mountain Clan]] and in about [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] contacted the clan to request that he be granted permission to enter the plain, so that he could visit the [[Star/Legends|Star]] [[Temple]]. Pavan was granted access to the ruin and he was escorted across the Infinity Plain to the temple by the [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomiri]] [[Force Adept|adept]] [[Magash Drashi]].
